:::{#def-diagonal-problem}
#### The diagonal problem

The **diagonal problem** UC is the [decision problem](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem)
whose yes inputs are the strings $w$ such that
the machine $M_w$ that $w$ [describes](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-description),
run on its own [description](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-description) $w$,
does not [halt](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine)
with [output](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine) $1$:

$$\text{UC} \eqdef \set{w \in \set{0, 1}^* : M_w(w) \ne 1},$$

where $M_w(w) \ne 1$ includes the case that $M_w$ never halts on $w$
[@arora2009computational, section 1.5].

:::
